description.en: Adds a global "Maximum model request retries" setting (0/1/2/3/5/10, default 2) to Settings > General in DeepSeek Harness; the runtime honors it for every normal-mode provider retry policy. Pure plugin, install is behavior-neutral.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 设置 > 通用中新增全局的「模型请求最大重试次数」选项（0/1/2/3/5/10，默认 2），运行时对 normal 模式的 provider 重试策略生效。纯插件实现，安装后行为不变。
